title: Slovakian Vegan Gnocchi with Garlic Sauce
description: A traditional Slovakian dish adapted to be vegan-friendly, featuring homemade gnocchi and a rich garlic sauce. This hearty meal is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Combine the mashed potatoes with flour and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal parts and roll each part into a long rope.
Cut the rope into 1-inch pieces to form the gnocchi.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegan butter and stir until melted.
Add the nutritional yeast and stir to combine.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the gnocchi for 3-5 minutes.
Drain the gnocchi and add to the garlic sauce.
Toss the gnocchi in the sauce until well coated.
